summary: With external ingress, set CSRF on the ingress: in Advanced Configuration add ingress annotations and a TLS secret, and add extra_settings CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS with your domain to the AAP spec.
questions: How do I set CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS for the platform gateway on OpenShift?
CSRF verification failed with external ingress
How do I configure ingress annotations for the gateway?

answer_card.title: CSRF for external ingress
answer_card.answer_md:
Edit AnsibleAutomationPlatform > Advanced Configuration (ingress annotations, ingress TLS secret), and in YAML:
```yaml
spec:
  extra_settings:
    - setting: CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
      value:
        - https://my-aap-domain.com
```
